title: Shared storage, two linked lists
description: Implement Pool(capacity) for two sorted singly linked lists sharing one fixed node pool. Public data and next arrays have capacity slots; heads is [head0,head1]; free is the free-list head; -1 is null. Initially every slot is free and data entries None. insert(which,value) returns False if that list already contains value or storage is full; otherwise allocate from free and insert ascending. delete(which,value) returns False if absent; otherwise clear its data and recycle the slot to the front of free. values(which) traverses that list. which is 0 or 1; capacity is positive. The same value may exist in both lists. Use the arrays for storage; no additional dynamic value list.
hints: Separate validation, state changes and output.
Try an empty case, an exact boundary and repeated operations.
rubric: Explain why every slot belongs to exactly one live list or the free chain, including after a failed insertion.
